name: platelet derived growth factor D
pathways: positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction

function.text: PDGFD encodes platelet-derived growth factor D [Cleaved into: Platelet-derived growth factor D, latent form; Platelet-derived growth factor D, receptor-binding form]. Annotated molecular activities include growth factor activity and platelet-derived growth factor receptor binding. It participates in positive regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction and positive regulation of cell migration.
